## NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework and Its Generative AI Profile

NIST released the AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) in January 2023 as a voluntary, broad framework for helping organizations incorporate trustworthiness considerations throughout the AI lifecycle—from design and development to use and evaluation.

In July 2024, NIST published AI 600-1, a cross-sector companion profile focused on generative AI. The two publications are related but distinct in scope: the AI RMF addresses AI broadly, while the later profile focuses on generative AI. Its status as a companion profile does not, on its own, mean that it replaces the broader framework.
